title: Motorized fader
subtitle: Adafruit 5466 / 100 mm / 10 kohm
notes: Motor and potentiometer are electrically separate. Confirm pot ends and wiper with a meter; tape labels A/B/C are user labels, not universal factory pin numbering. Leave touch terminal open. Manufacturer lists motor 6-10 V but reports operation at 5 V; actual startup/stall current is unmeasured.
